# JARVIS-OS — machine-readable CLI reference

Local-first AI system. CLI-first. Everything below runs on your machine;
state lives in `--home` (default `~/.jarvis-os`).

## Conventions (for agents)

- Read-only commands print JSON with `--json` and exit 0 on success.
- Health gates exit non-zero on failure: `doctor`, `service doctor`,
  `task doctor` (use them in scripts and CI).
- Mutations NEVER run from prose: approvals use single-use tokens
  (`approvals approve --token <tok>`), dangerous targets need explicit flags.
- The HTTP API (`serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --token <tok>`)
  exposes `GET /health /status /events /api/board` and the read-only
  status page at `/board`. POST routes actuate — gate them.

## Command map

- Ask: `talk "<request>"` (one-shot) · `repl` (interactive)
- Health: `doctor` (deps/hardware/models) · `service doctor` ·
  `task doctor` · `status` (system JSON)
- Observe: `board [--open]` (dashboard URL) · `serve` (API+WS) ·
  `remote` (phone/local remote URL) · `/experience` page + 
  `GET /api/experience` (command-center snapshot) ·
  `POST /api/tasks/<id>/<advance|pause|resume|cancel|recover>` ·
  `POST /api/approvals/decision` (single-use token in body)
- `command` (AI command centre at `/command`: elfaria-style layout,
  100% live data) · `POST /api/tasks` (file a mission) ·
  `GET /api/tasks/<id>` (steps for checklists)
- Memory: `remember <fact>` · `consolidate`
- Agents/work: `agents` · `dots` · `missions` · `task create/run/inspect/recover`
- Proof/review: `proof <claim>` (receipts or honest unverified) ·
  `feedback <text>` · `setup` (checklist, exit 1 on failure) ·
  `voice profile [--style]` · `status-summary`
- Voice/audio: `say/say` (`say`, `listen`) · `audio` · `voice` · `voice-test`
- World: `world` (sources, search, events, research)
- Policy: `approvals` · `grants` · `autonomy`
- Ops: `service` (lifecycle/health/logs) · `backup` · `benchmark` ·
  `devices` · `pi` · `integration`
- Security: `security review` (static self-review) ·
  `security scan` (dynamic scan via Strix sandbox, policy-gated)

## Rules for agentic use

1. Prefer `--json` and parse it; never scrape human-readable text.
2. Check `doctor` before diagnosing; check `task doctor` before touching tasks.
3. Never pass secrets on the command line; use env or the vault.
4. A successful run is not proof: look for `verification: verified`,
   not merely `ok: true`.
5. Dynamic security scans (`security scan`) run ONLY against targets you
   own or have explicit written permission to test.
